label: ThinkPad T14 Gen 5 14-inch business laptop
description: 14-inch Core Ultra (Series 1) business laptop. Networking is a real onboard RJ-45 at Gigabit Ethernet (Intel I219-LM on vPro models, I219-V otherwise, Wake-on-LAN) plus Intel Wi-Fi 6E AX211 2x2 with Bluetooth 5.3, or the optional Intel Wi-Fi 7 BE200 2x2 with Bluetooth 5.4. Optional WWAN is Quectel RM520N-GL 5G sub-6 with eSIM. Ports: 1x RJ-45, 2x Thunderbolt 4/USB4 40 Gbps, 2x USB-A 5 Gbps, HDMI 2.1, nano-SIM on WWAN models.
notes: The RJ-45 here is 1 GbE, not 2.5G - Lenovo's PSREF names the I219 PHY, so rounding it up would be wrong. Wi-Fi generation is a build option: AX211 is 6E, BE200 is 7; the catalogue entry states 6E as the base SKU and the notes carry the 7 option rather than claiming Wi-Fi 7 across the board.
